description: The graph illustrates the performance of two models, SMoE Validating and SimSMoE Validating, measured by BPC (Bits Per Character) across training steps. The x-axis represents the number of training steps, scaled by a factor of 10³, ranging from 0 to 50,000, with labeled tick marks at intervals of 10,000. The y-axis shows the BPC value, ranging from 1.2 to 2.2, with gridlines at intervals of 0.2. The black line, representing SMoE Validating, starts at a BPC of approximately 2.2 at 0 training steps and exhibits a sharp initial decline, leveling off to a stable value of around 1.18 by 50,000 steps. The magenta line, representing SimSMoE Validating, begins at a slightly lower BPC of about 2.15 and follows a similar trajectory, decreasing rapidly in the early stages and stabilizing at a value of approximately 1.16 by the end of training. Both models converge to nearly identical BPC values, with SimSMoE Validating achieving a marginally lower performance throughout the training process.
